description_excerpt: Job Description Project Secretary & BDE – Chinese Speaking (B&I) Provide Mandarin–Vietnamese interpretation and project coordination support for SGS B&I assignments, while supporting business development with Chinese-speaking clients in Northern Vietnam. Allocate approximately 50% of working time to project/site support and 50% to Hanoi office-based BD, tender and client activities, including client visits, under a monthly plan agreed by the B&I Manager with the PM and BD team.
